accepted_state: Initial eight-area capability expansion is complete.
Default operating phase is hardening, consolidation, outcome validation, and gap-oriented learning rather than default skill expansion.
GitHub mutation guard contracts exist and remain CI-validated; native provider interception is deferred unless a controllable dispatcher surface becomes available.
Every live skill entrypoint has a consolidation classification and routing overlap clusters have machine-readable primary ownership rules.
Skill Acquisition is phase-gated and must not trigger a new expansion wave without explicit request or demonstrated gap.
Agent Engineering treats executor/model claims as candidate state and requires evidence-appropriate promotion into durable accepted state.
Tracing and evaluation are separate layers, with privacy-minimal typed trajectory metadata preferred over raw conversation logging.
Context engineering now uses explicit write/select/compress/isolate operators instead of treating memory or summarization as one undifferentiated action.
Context selection is reference-first and freshness-aware: volatile authoritative state must be refreshed when staleness can change the next action.
Compaction is a lossy optimization rather than a new source of truth; protected decision anchors and recoverable source references must survive when relevant.
Isolated workers should return compact evidence, uncertainty, conclusions, and references rather than full transcript dumps.
Executable continuity checkpoint state remains CI-validated.
unresolved_risks: The public Core guard cannot intercept native provider GitHub tools unless the host routes mutation calls through it.
Eight skills remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE and should not be promoted to stronger consolidation decisions without representative outcomes.
Routing boundaries, verified-state promotion, trajectory contracts, and context-operator contracts remain contract-level refinements until real-task evidence accumulates.
Compaction can still lose future-relevant nuance; source/reference recoverability reduces but does not eliminate that risk.
Available host surfaces do not expose uniform token accounting or full replayable context state, so global context-efficiency percentages must not be invented.
A separate auditor or isolated sub-agent is not assumed to improve every task; topology must remain evidence-driven and smallest-sufficient.

next_executable_step.action: On ordinary real tasks, apply write/select/compress/isolate only when needed; observe stale-source refreshes, unnecessary context reads, compaction recovery, transcript-dump avoidance, rework, and correctness. Promote real failures into regression cases and do not claim token or latency gains where the host does not expose comparable measurements.
